launch_template: source /mnt/data/shared/config/env.sh && GENESIS_IMAGE_VER=1_26 gs-srun --partition=rtx-mid --ntasks=1 --gpus=1 --cpus-per-task=8 --mem=64G --time=00:20:00 bash; cd indicated checkout; source research/rigid_stress/scripts/cluster_env.sh; run argv with stdout/stderr redirected under data_root. CPU tests omit --gpus=1.
notes: Final engine/example/benchmark numerical source is dbfdf20d; later completion commit changes documentation, evidence, optional audit/archive helpers and option docstrings only.
Selected throughput includes resets, controller, changing footprints, all recovery stages and stated policy work. Frozen recovery is not live throughput.
Early profile-baseline/cooperative/grid B8 tables re-associated post-integration pose and are development hotspot diagnostics, not identical-input final ablations.
compare-cdf0-fp32 is a superseded debugging run with wrong inverse correction sign; corrected mixed measurement is correction-fp32-b1024.

pressure-warp v1 source was superseded in a working checkout. The archived pressure-warp-trial.patch reproduces the v2 numerical implementation on 6a048825. Final dbfdf20d adds explicit serial pressure option and conditional pair allocation.

native-suite-final.log contains the two checkpoint-test assumption failures. checkpoint-lifecycle-final.log verifies corrected expectations. native-selected-gpu/cpu are the final accepted complete suites.
final-memory sampler is a preceding 6a048825 whole-card sampled footprint, not the exact final high-water mark. Final per-buffer ledger is in selected JSON.
Full traces and diagnostic RHS arrays are runtime data, not Git artifacts. Their names/hashes are recorded below.
Large log preambles omit duplicated printed JSON; the complete original JSON is separately gzip archived. Original and archive byte counts/hashes are distinct.
